acceptanceCriteria: A doccorpus spec section defines docs corpus eval with numbered requirements and failure modes.
eval scores caller cases through the same code path as the MCP tools and reports unresolved expected IDs, proven by tests.
--baseline lists every regressed case and exits non-zero; changed case file or corpus identity is reported not comparable, proven by tests.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1480. DCP-V1-020's labelled evaluation exists only as internal/doccorpus/evaluation_test.go over a synthetic fixture. Requested: corvint docs corpus eval --artifact --cases [--baseline] [--format]; caller-owned cases {id, operation, arguments, expect{subjects,claims,paths,abstain,must_not}, tags}; unresolved expected IDs reported; per-case hit/rank/P@k/R@k/abstention/must_not/latency/bytes via the MCP tool code path; per-operation and per-tag summary with denominators and identities; --baseline ratchet exits non-zero on any regression, non-comparable when cases or corpus identity change; synthetic cases labelled.
